Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 7, 2026

What this site is

gettysburginteractivemap.com is a free, ad-free, no-login animated map of the Battle of Gettysburg. There is no account system, no payment of any kind, and no data sold to anyone.

Information we collect

  • Real User Monitoring (Netlify). Aggregate, anonymous performance data — page load times, layout stability, responsiveness — used only to see whether the site is fast for real visitors. It cannot identify you.
  • Mapbox. The map tiles are served by Mapbox, which receives standard request data (IP address, approximate location, browser type) needed to serve map imagery, under Mapbox's own privacy policy.
  • Google Street View. Where a page embeds a Street View panel (documentary and report pages), that iframe is served directly by Google, under Google's privacy policy. We don't see anything from that embed ourselves.
  • Local storage, on your device only. Your saved bookmarks, whether you've seen the intro screen, and display preferences are stored in your browser's localStorage. This never leaves your device and we never see it.

What we don't do

No account creation, no email collection, no advertising trackers, no third-party analytics beyond the performance monitoring above, no selling or sharing of any data.

Cookies

This site does not set its own cookies. Mapbox and Google may set cookies as part of serving map tiles and Street View imagery, governed by their own policies linked above.

Children's privacy

This site is often used in classrooms. It collects no personal information from any visitor, including students, and requires no sign-up of any kind.

Changes to this policy

If what this site collects or how it works changes, this page will be updated and the date at the top will change.

Contact

Questions about this policy: gettysburginteractivemap@gmail.com
